A_horse_profiles_parsed.note: May 24 (1 profile: Bow Echo) and May 25 (59 profiles) have no form_history built yet. Parser was run only for May 26-27.

C_avg_runs_per_horse.note: 161 horses, 2228 runs. Includes horses with 0 runs (maidens).

E_dates_covered_in_run_history.note: Eligible (70 runs) dates back to 2018-09-22. Most horses 2020-2026.

G_jockey_coverage.note: jockey_rp_uid extracted from href='/profile/jockey/{uid}/' links. Approx 5% have name but no uid (non-linked jockeys). Extremely high name coverage.

H_trainer_coverage.note: Trainer is NOT extracted from form table rows — the hp-formTable does not include trainer per run. Trainer is available in horse_profiles.json (current trainer only, not per-run trainer history). This is a MISSING field in the form history parser.

I_result_position_coverage.note: Approx 6% of runs have no parsed position. These are typically horses with 0 parsed runs (maidens/unraced) or malformed position cells.

J_field_size_coverage.note: Field size extracted from position cell 'N / M' pattern. Same coverage as position — they come from same cell.

K_sp_coverage.note: SP from cell[6] only (corrected in PR #3). Extremely high coverage. Remaining nulls are races with no SP data recorded (e.g. walkovers).

L_distance_going_coverage.note: Both from simple text cells — near-complete coverage.

fields_null_over_20_percent.reason: Not in form table per-run row. Only current trainer in horse_profiles.json.
Gear suffix (e.g. 'p', 't') only present when worn — most runs have no gear.
Only populated for non-winning runs where winner is listed. WIN result_type rows have no winner_name.

N_parse_failures.note: Zero failures for May 26 (70 horses) and May 27 (91 horses). Parser handled all HTML files without exception.

zero_run_horses.reason: These are lightly-raced or debut horses — no form table rows in HTML, not parser failures.
